headings.usage: Hero typography, section titles. Must use tracking-tighter.

labels.usage: Prices, em-dash section labels (— About), tiny uppercase overlines.

visual_enhancers.texture: Global subtle grain/noise overlay using a fixed background div with opacity-10 mix-blend-overlay.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with a 1px border-white/10 for the sticky navigation.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #27272A (zinc-800) for separating sections, lists, and the membership card.
visual_enhancers.image_treatment: Black/white or desaturated filters on hover, subtle scale-up. Hero image should have a vignette or gradient overlay so text pops.

layouts.hero: 100vh height. Kinetic text reveal for 'The best barber in Oxford.' Text is massive (text-5xl md:text-7xl). The hero image is placed in a tight editorial frame or as a darkened background.
layouts.about: Asymmetric bento or 2-column grid. Left: Sticky '— About' label. Right: Numbered manifesto chapters (01. The Origin - Loved barbering before clippers, 02. The Journey - Self taught since 2022, 03. The Barber - 25 yrs old, Oxford based).
layouts.gallery: Grid of varied image sizes (e.g., col-span-2 row-span-2 mixed with col-span-1). Em-dash '— The work' label. High-contrast gaps.
layouts.services: List layout. Clean borders between items. Name on left, price on right, description under name. Minimalist.
layouts.membership: A standalone luxury card layout. Use a subtle tracing beam or metallic border. Highlights 'VIP x4' and '£64/month'.
layouts.footer_map: Dark-themed map (Mapbox/Google static) on one side, Opening hours table on the other. Large footer CTA 'Book a cut'.

motion.scroll: MUST use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.reveals: Framer Motion for line-by-line text reveals (masking) on headings.
motion.marquee: react-fast-marquee for a slow, elegant editorial ribbon at the bottom or between sections.
motion.parallax: Subtle y-axis parallax on gallery images using framer-motion useScroll.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure white text on the #050505 background. Muted text must be at least #A1A1AA.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all framer-motion animations.

hero_texture.description: Dark noise texture for background overlay

personal_story.passion: Loved the idea of cutting hair before even picking up a pair of clippers

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/react-lenis, react-fast-marquee, lucide-react
Avoid using Shadcn components for the marketing structure (use raw HTML/Tailwind for artistic overlapping/asymmetry). Shadcn is fine for small interactive bits if needed.
Do NOT use standard default fonts like Roboto or Open Sans for headings. Use Playfair Display imported from Google Fonts.
Construct the site as a single-page scrolling experience with anchor links in the sticky navigation.
Ensure 'Book Now' buttons link out to the booking URL.
For the gallery, use a CSS grid with different spanning sizes (e.g., col-span-2 row-span-2) and render the image URLs provided.
Strictly follow the color palette to achieve an editorial, near-black, high-contrast aesthetic.
Use uppercase, wide-tracked monospace fonts for all section labels starting with an em-dash (e.g., '— ABOUT').
Create standard components using .js or .jsx, NOT .tsx, as specified in the guidelines.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
